headline: Commission to review and score applications for the Youth Climate Action Fund (YCAF).
summary: The commission will go over the YCAF application guidelines and scoring rubric, then read and score submitted applications before discussing them as a group. It will also plan its next meeting agenda.
items: Overview of YCAF application guidelines and evaluation rubric
Individual reading and scoring of submitted YCAF applications
Discussion of agenda for next meeting, including possible MyRWA's CLEANAIR presentation and Black Earth Compost
Confirmation of date/time for next meeting
location: City Hall Room 113, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA 02148
